blame.carry: You dealt the most damage in {topRate} of your losses and barely fed. The team let you down.
blame.weak: In your losses you took {deathShare} of your team's deaths and rarely topped the damage. Look in the mirror first.
blame.team: In your losses you were about average for your team: {damageShare} of its damage. Nobody to blame, or everybody.

sessions.contrast: A {bestWins}-{bestLosses} night and a {worstWins}-{worstLosses} one. Same player, different evenings.
sessions.marathon: {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} in one sitting. Hydrate.
sessions.best: Your best night went {wins}-{losses}. Chase it.

early.early: Ahead of your lane opponent at 15 minutes in {ahead} of games, and you close them out. An early-game bully.
early.late: Behind at 15 minutes in {behind} of games, yet you still win {comeback} of those. You scale, and you never give up.
early.steady: Ahead at 15 in {ahead} of games and behind in {behind}. The game is decided later.

tierlist.uniform: Your whole pool sits in {tier} tier, led by {best} at {winRate}.
tierlist.leadOther: Nothing reached S tier. {best} leads your list in {tier} tier at {winRate}.
tierlist.lastOther: {worst} is at the bottom, in {tier} tier, with {winRate}.

items.better: You win {withIt} of games with {name} and {without} without it. It's doing something right.
items.worse: Your win rate is lower when you build {name} ({withIt} vs {without}). Loyalty, or habit?
items.habit: {name} ended {share} of your games. Some habits you keep.
items.friend: {name} finished {share} of your games. A reliable friend.

habits.flashEdge: Flash on {key}, {perGame} casts a game. You live on the edge.
habits.flashCalm: Flash on {key}, {perGame} casts a game. You save it for when it counts.
habits.pair: {a} and {b} in {share} of your games. You know what you like.
habits.surrenderOften: {rate} of your games ended in a surrender. Somebody always has somewhere to be.
habits.surrenderUs: Your team gave up more often than the enemy did ({weQuit} to {enemyQuit}). Stay optimistic.
habits.surrenderThem: The other team waved the white flag {enemyQuit} times against your {weQuit}. They saw you coming.
habits.surrenderRare: Only {rate} of your games ended in a surrender. You play them out.

getBackPings.label: Get back
getBackPings.title: The Worrier
getBackPings.line: You spend your pings telling people to retreat. Your team is alive because of you.

enemyMissingPings.label: Enemy missing
enemyMissingPings.title: The Lookout
enemyMissingPings.line: "Missing!" is your catchphrase. Nobody walks into the fog without you knowing.

onMyWayPings.label: On my way
onMyWayPings.title: The Rescuer
onMyWayPings.line: You're always on the way. Whether you arrive is another story.

assistMePings.label: Assist me
assistMePings.title: The Instigator
assistMePings.line: You ping for help and the team comes running. Or so you hope.

needVisionPings.label: Need vision
needVisionPings.title: The Vision Beggar
needVisionPings.line: Somebody, please place a ward. You ask every game.

commandPings.label: Command
commandPings.title: The Commander
commandPings.line: You point at the map and expect the team to follow. Mostly they do.

pushPings.label: Push
pushPings.title: The Wave Pusher
pushPings.line: Push, push, push. You want that tower down now.

holdPings.label: Hold
holdPings.title: The Wall
holdPings.line: Hold the line. You are the calm voice in a chaotic lobby.

allInPings.label: All in
allInPings.title: The All-In Merchant
allInPings.line: When you ping all-in, the fight is happening whether people like it or not.

enemyVisionPings.label: Enemy vision
enemyVisionPings.title: The Spotter
enemyVisionPings.line: You call out every enemy ward. Nothing hides from you.

visionClearedPings.label: Vision cleared
visionClearedPings.title: The Janitor
visionClearedPings.line: You clear the wards and tell everyone about it.

tilt.tilt: You win {afterWin} after a win but only {afterLoss} after a loss. Maybe take a walk between games.
tilt.resilient: Lose one and you win {afterLoss} of the next, more than the {afterWin} after a win. Losses just fire you up.
tilt.steady: {afterWin} after a win, {afterLoss} after a loss. Nothing shakes you.

comfort.trust: {best} lifts you to {bestRate}. A pick you can trust.
comfort.drag: {best} lifts you to {bestRate}. {worst} drags you down to {worstRate}. Time to let it go?

gray.heavy: That's {share} of every game staring at the gray screen. The fountain knows you by name.
gray.some: About {minutes} minutes a game respawning. It adds up.
gray.light: Only {share} of your time dead. The gray screen barely knows you.

modes.aramPenta: {penta, plural, one {# pentakill} other {# pentakills}} on the bridge. The Abyss brings out your chaos.
modes.aramKills: {kills} kills a game. A brawl is where you thrive.
modes.aramBetter: You win more in the Abyss than on the Rift. Snowballing suits you.
modes.aramWorse: The Rift treats you better than the Abyss. That bridge is a wild place.
modes.aramSteady: {top} carried you through the chaos. Steady, just like on the Rift.
modes.normalBetter: You play better with nothing on the line. Your normals beat your ranked win rate.
modes.normalWorse: Ranked brings out your best. Normals are your warm-up lap.
modes.normalExplore: {unique, plural, one {# different champion} other {# different champions}} in {games, plural, one {# normal} other {# normals}}. This is where you experiment.
modes.normalMain: {top} was your go-to when nothing was on the line ({winRate} wins).

objectives.stolen: {count, plural, one {# objective} other {# objectives}} stolen. Somewhere, an enemy jungler is still upset.
objectives.firstTower: Get the first tower: you win {withIt} of games with it and {without} without.
objectives.firstDragon: Get the first dragon: you win {withIt} of games with it and {without} without.
objectives.firstHerald: Get the first Herald: you win {withIt} of games with it and {without} without.
objectives.firstBaron: Get the first Baron: you win {withIt} of games with it and {without} without.
objectives.turrets: You took {share} of your team's turrets. Demolition is a team sport, and you're the demolition.
objectives.barons: {count, plural, one {# Baron} other {# Barons}} secured. When the pit opens, you're there.
objectives.dragons: {count, plural, one {# dragon} other {# dragons}} secured. The Rift's wildlife fears you.
objectives.default: Your teams took {dragons, plural, one {# dragon} other {# dragons}} and {towers, plural, one {# turret} other {# turrets}} across these games. Every objective counts.

spellslinger.line: {share} of your damage is magic. Armor is a suggestion.

steel.line: {share} of your damage is physical. Enemies who build armor hate you.

trueDamage.line: {share} of your damage ignores resistances entirely. Sneaky.

mixed.line: Physical and magic in balance. The enemy can't stack just one resist.

lane.bully: You finish ahead of your lane opponent on gold in {rate} of games, by {gold} gold on average. Lane bully.
lane.behind: Your lane opponent out-earns you in {rate} of games. Time to look at your wave management.
lane.even: You and your lane opponent trade blows evenly: ahead on gold in {rate} of games.

gold.high: You ended games with {gold} gold unspent on average. That's an item you never bought.
gold.mid: About {gold} gold left over at the end of a game. Not bad, not perfect.
gold.low: Only {gold} gold unspent. You spend it as fast as you earn it.

comp.better: With a {class} on your team you win {withRate}, against {withoutRate} without. Ask for one.
comp.worse: With a {class} on your team you win only {withRate} ({withoutRate} without). Coincidence, or curse?

progress.flat: Nothing has really moved since then. Consistency is a skill.
progress.allUp: Better across the board: {better} of {total} stats are up, and none slipped.
progress.allDown: A rougher stretch: {worse} of {total} stats are down. Every climb has dips.
progress.moreUp: More up than down: {better} stats improved and {worse} slipped.
progress.mixed: A mixed bag: {better} stats improved, {worse} slipped.

tiltguard.stop: After {losses} losses in a row you win {rate} of the next game, against {base} usually. That's your stop sign.
tiltguard.keepGoing: And you queue up again {keep} of the time.
tiltguard.steady: Even after {losses} losses in a row you win {rate}. Streaks don't shake you.
tiltguard.liveStop: You're {run} losses deep right now, and after a streak like this you win {rate} of the next game. Maybe stop here.
tiltguard.liveInfo: You're on a {run}-loss streak right now. After one like it you win {rate} of the next game.

formcurve.swing: From {worst} at your lowest to {best} at your highest, {games} at a time.
formcurve.steady: Over any {games} you stayed between {worst} and {best}. Very steady.
formcurve.hot: Lately you're hot: {now} over your last {games}, against {avg} for the season.
formcurve.cold: Lately it's been rougher: {now} over your last {games}, against {avg} for the season.
formcurve.even: Lately you're right at your usual: {now} over your last {games}, {avg} for the season.

patches.swing: You did best on patch {best} ({bestRate}) and worst on patch {worst} ({worstRate}).
patches.steady: Patch after patch you stayed between {worstRate} and {bestRate}. New patches barely move you.

runes.better: {best} wins {bestRate} for you, against {favoriteRate} with {favorite}. Worth taking more often?
runes.loyal: {name} in {share} of your games. Once you find a keystone, you stick with it.
runes.plain: {name} is your keystone: {rate} win rate over {games}.

championPage.worse: {name} is a tougher one: {rate} against {overall} overall.
championPage.level: {name} is right at your usual: {rate}, {overall} overall.
